hypothesis_text: When LLM agents bid in a sealed-bid second-price auction with private valuations, providing the mechanism description in the prompt INCREASES bid-shading rather than reducing it — i.e., the LLM departs further from the dominant-strategy truthful bid when told the mechanism is incentive-compatible.
prior_art_summary: The standard analytical result is that explaining a DSIC mechanism should make rational agents bid truthfully. No published LLM-in-auction result we are aware of reports the opposite empirical pattern.
rationale: Predicts a counter-intuitive direction. If true, it overturns the naive expectation about LLM mechanism-compliance — high novelty by surprise.
